assignments.node_id: העקר תלוי ברצון, אם רצונו חזק מאד להתקרב להשם יתברך ולעבד אותו, רק שקשה לו לשבר תאוות גופו, אז על־ידי התקרבות ואמונת הצדיקים
assignments.reason: This node describes strong will to serve God combined with closeness to and faith in the Tzaddikim (התקרבות ואמונת הצדיקים). Its essential nature is אמונת הצדיקים — faith in the Tzaddik — which is the core identity of Package 1 (ארץ = אמונה = הצדיק). The רצון (will) is the prerequisite disposition, but the node's defining content is the mechanism of drawing close to the Tzaddik through emunah, placing it squarely in the ארץ/אמונה/הצדיק cluster.

assignments.node_id: הוא בחינת אכילה, ונאכל להצדיק, הינו שנתהפך למהותו כנ"ל
assignments.reason: This node describes being absorbed by the Tzaddik and transformed into his essence — the core metaphor of the Torah where ארץ אוכלת יושביה. The 'eating' here is the Tzaddik-as-ארץ absorbing the person, which is the defining function of Package 1. The node is explicitly called 'בחינת אכילה' in the context of the Tzaddik's transformative power, making it an expression of the ארץ/אמונה/הצדיק nature.

Attachment to the Tzaddik (דבוק להצדיק) and faith in him (מאמין בו) are the two defining aspects of Package 1: הצדיק and אמונה. The node names both core concepts of the package — the Tzaddik and emunah — as a unified act. Its essential nature is identical with the package's identity.

assignments.node_id: נאכל להצדיק ונתהפך למהות הצדיק ממש
assignments.reason: Being absorbed by the Tzaddik and transformed into the Tzaddik's very essence — this is the culmination of the ארץ אוכלת יושביה principle. The node's essential nature is the Tzaddik's transformative absorption, which is the defining identity of Package 1 (הצדיק כבחינת ארץ). It describes the same reality as the package's core metaphor.

Subduing the material (להכניע החומר) is the essential act of the mind/soul asserting dominance over the body — 'שהנפש תאכל הבשר, שתתהפך למהותה'. Its essential nature belongs to the domain of מוח ודעת overcoming physicality. The Rebbe frames it as 'לאכול את בשרי' — the soul eating the flesh — which is the internal parallel to Package 1's external Tzaddik-absorption. The holy mind (Package 2) is the agent doing the subduing; this node names that very act.

This node describes the drawing near of the 'two inseparable companions' (תרין רעין דלא מתפרשין), which the Rebbe explicitly identifies as the holy mochin (מוחין קדושים = מוח ודעת). The node's essential nature IS the תרין רעין — the dominant concept of Package 2. Though the node describes their 'drawing near' (an event), the identity of what draws near is the Package 2 cluster itself.
